title: See CI results and timings for the remaining script tests in Intent

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The existing CI workflow assertion catches a retirement proof fragment bound to the wrong command report.

- Story `SEED-111#run-uncovered-script-tests-in-ci`, revision `9d49aeaea0041309045460fb47a7671bdca97ba4`. Its scope and first key example require each of the 18 files to publish its outcomes and recorded duration under the selected attempt's `scripts` entry. The source is recoverable at `.planning/seeds/SEED-111-run-uncovered-script-tests-in-ci.md#run-uncovered-script-tests-in-ci` in that revision.
- One plausible copy-paste fault changed `.github/lint_and_generated_types/action.yml` line 108 from the `test:worktree-retirement.ndjson` report to `test:development-stack.ndjson`, leaving the retirement command, test fixture, and assertion intact. This binds scripts part 12 to another command's report.
- The fixture in `scripts/ci/workflow-fixtures.mjs` reads and parses the actual workflow and composite action. The maintained test `each Node test command in lint:all reports its own scripts part after the Bash part` compares those producer bindings to `package.json` command order at `scripts/ci/ci-workflow.test.mjs` line 128. The failure showed part 12's actual development-stack report against the expected worktree-retirement report, establishing reach to the intended assertion.
- An isolated scratch worktree at `/tmp/seed111-intent-coverage`, branch `codex/seed111-intent-coverage`, started clean at the selected revision. All three runs used the identical maintained command `./scripts/run.sh pnpm test:ci-proof`. Baseline passed 25/25. The fault run exited 1 with 24 passed and the selected assertion failed. After restoring the sole edited file, the scratch status matched its initial empty status and the restored run passed 25/25. The scratch worktree and temporary branch were removed safely. Logs and the fault diff remain under `/tmp/seed111-intent-{baseline,fault,restored}.log` and `/tmp/seed111-intent-fault.diff`.
- **Test runtime.** Measured Node runner durations were 824.914916 ms baseline, 826.064833 ms fault, and 818.311291 ms restored, totaling 2469.291040 ms. These exclude Nix and dependency setup.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable because no separate human-time measurement was supplied or collected for this check.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable because the host exposes no separate active-agent effort or token-usage measurement for this invocation.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 145574 ms (measured), from 1794217163000 to 1794217308574 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
